scope: Startup to explicit postfixture completion stop before engine teardown; includes admission/manual/automatic advances, fixed probes and fixture cleanup. Excludes engine teardown and unfinished wrapper calls. Not whole-process or automatic-tick-only.
limits: Actual dynamic function counts; inclusive scopes overlap. Preserve decimal display precision; do not subtract transitive probe calls, sum inclusive rows, or derive per-tick/FPS/causal costs.
